record_title: Square-root bounded-stopping bias under linear-wise independent Rademacher increments
provenance: Exact stopped-sum envelope from a pathwise simple-walk maximum bound, finite-field character constructions, and binary-code minimum-distance realizations.
limitations: The exact constant is for a two-iid-block class; the unrestricted fixed-fraction theorem is order-sharp rather than constant-sharp. The coding lower bound is sufficient rather than rate-distance optimal, and terminology-equivalent prior coverage remains a residual originality risk.
